name: risen_reef_a_nonland_top_card_goes_to_hand_without_a_choice
notes: Printed: 'If it's a land card, you may put it onto the battlefield tapped. If you don't put the card onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.' The top card is an Instant: no may-offer is made (a step without decisions raises at any ask), and the Instant goes to hand. The card below it stays in the library.
